note: POC-05 environment tuning (reversible initial values). The time of day is derived from SimClock.elapsed only: hour = fposmod(start_hour + elapsed / day_seconds * 24, 24).

paving.note: Opt-in fixture pavement (poc_main applies it before loading; direct Session users such as the POC-02/04 logic tests see none). Cell rects [x, y, w, h]; only wasteland cells are repaved.

readability.note: POL-01 display-only readability aids. marker = filled disc under the feet (depth-tested, not an outline); player_light = weak night light that follows the player; lamps = night OmniLight3D at every placed asset 'asset' (head_local in the lamp's holder frame). Light energies are multiplied by the night factor of the game clock.
